description: React component for an admin console team filter dropdown with async loading and search capabilities.

classes.name: Props
classes.description: Props interface extending Redux props, including filter options and update function.

classes.name: TeamSelectOption
classes.description: Type representing options in the team select dropdown with label and value.

methods.name: loadListInPageNumber
methods.description: Loads a page of teams and updates the list state.

methods.name: searchInList
methods.description: Searches for teams matching a term, returns matching options.

methods.name: handleMenuScrolledToBottom
methods.description: Loads more teams when the dropdown menu is scrolled to bottom.

methods.name: handleOnChange
methods.description: Handles selection changes, updates filter values accordingly.
